resources.string: Dashwheel learns what your car usually reads and speaks up when the last drives drift away from it, before a fault code shows up.
Warns when a reading drifts from the car\'s usual
Replaced the part? Start again so it learns the new usual.
The battery has been resting lower than usual for a few drives: %1$s volts against %2$s. Worth having it tested.
The charging voltage has dropped to %1$s volts, from a usual %2$s. Worth checking the alternator and its belt.
The charging voltage has risen to %1$s volts, from a usual %2$s. Worth checking the alternator\'s regulator.
The engine is taking longer to warm up: %1$s minutes against a usual %2$s. The thermostat may be sticking open.
The engine runs cooler than usual once warm: %1$s degrees against %2$s. The thermostat may be sticking open.
The engine runs warmer than usual: %1$s degrees against %2$s. Worth checking the coolant level and the fan.
The idle speed has gone up to %1$s revs a minute, from a usual %2$s.
The idle speed has dropped to %1$s revs a minute, from a usual %2$s.
The particle filter is cleaning itself more often: every %1$s %3$s lately, against %2$s usually.
